ChaliceOfBaal.description: The first time each turn that any unit adjacent to <style="Faction_BloodAngels">Nicodemus</style> dies, he <style="Healing">heals</style> himself and all friendly adjacent units for <style="Stat_Health">{[hp]} Health</style>. All affected units deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> with <style="NormalAttack">normal melee attacks</style> until the end of this turn.
